authorities.name: South African Nursing Council
authorities.verifies: Registration to practise as a nurse
authorities.hint: A SANC registration number has 8 digits.

authorities.name: Health Professions Council of South Africa
authorities.verifies: Registration to practise as a doctor
authorities.hint: An HPCSA medical practitioner number starts with MP and has 7 digits.

authorities.name: South African Pharmacy Council
authorities.hint: A SAPC pharmacy registration starts with Y and has 6 digits.

authorities.name: South African National Accreditation System
authorities.hint: A SANAS medical accreditation number starts with M and has 4 digits.

authorities.name: South African Police Service
authorities.hint: A SAPS clearance reference is two letters followed by 11 digits.

authorities.name: Department of Home Affairs
authorities.verifies: Identity, through an accredited verification provider
authorities.hint: A South African ID number has 13 digits and a check digit.

authorities.name: Companies and Intellectual Property Commission
authorities.verifies: That the company exists and who may sign for it
authorities.hint: A CIPC registration number looks like 2019/443871/07.

authorities.name: Road Traffic Management Corporation
authorities.verifies: Driving licence and professional driving permit
authorities.hint: A driving licence number has 12 digits.

authorities.name: South African Health Products Regulatory Authority
authorities.verifies: Licence to hold and distribute medicines or devices
authorities.hint: Enter the licence reference exactly as it appears on the certificate.

authorities.name: Professional indemnity insurer
authorities.verifies: Cover in force for the declared scope of practice
authorities.hint: Enter the policy number from your schedule of cover.

authorities.name: Issuing institution
authorities.verifies: Qualifications, checked with the institution that issued them
authorities.hint: Enter the certificate or diploma number.

authorities.name: MyThuso Clinical Governance
authorities.verifies: Training, references and undertakings held by MyThuso
authorities.hint: This check is completed by MyThuso and has nothing for you to enter.

roles.name: Registered nurse
roles.summary: Attends visits in patients' homes, takes observations and escalates.

scope.label: Scope of practice
scope.note: You are only ever dispatched to work inside your registered scope. The Control Tower cannot override that.

grants.refusal: An unvetted nurse is never offered a visit, and cannot be assigned to one by the Control Tower.
A nurse sees the summary for the visit in front of them, and only once every check passes.
The clinical record opens for the visit being attended. It is not a directory a nurse may browse.
A protected category is released by the patient, entry by entry. It is never opened by a scope, however senior the nurse.
Nothing may be written into a patient's record by somebody the platform has not cleared to attend them.

roles.name: Doctor
roles.summary: Reviews nurse submissions, signs decisions and prescribes.

scope.label: Scope of practice
scope.note: Asynchronous review and telemedicine are declared separately, because indemnity cover has to name them.

grants.refusal: A case cannot be signed by a doctor whose HPCSA registration is not current. The queue refuses the signature rather than warning about it.
Prescribing is withheld until the Section 22A prescribing authority is verified alongside the registration.
The review queue shows nothing until registration and indemnity are both in date.
A lapsed registration closes the record as well as the signature — reading it is part of practising.
A protected category is released by the patient, entry by entry, even to a treating doctor.
Results are withheld from a doctor whose registration is not current, held rather than shown.
A consultation is written under a registration. Without a current one there is nothing to write it under.
A test cannot be ordered against a patient by somebody not currently registered to interpret it.
A referral carries the referring clinician's registration to the person receiving it.

roles.name: Thuso Corner site
roles.summary: A community location where screening and identity recovery happen in person.

scope.label: Services offered
scope.note: A site offers only what its inspection covers. A room that passed for screening has not passed for vaccination.

grants.refusal: A site cannot receive patients until it has been inspected. A screening in a room without privacy is not a screening.
In-person identity recovery at a Corner is only offered at inspected sites with a trained, vetted attendant.
